annotations.target_phrase: the zero-g garden, floating globes of water, miniature bonsai trees
annotations.annotation_text: Straylight's interior garden features miniature bonsai trees rooted in nutrient moss and free-floating water spheres held together by surface tension. Gibson creates an eerie, sterile Eden that symbolizes the clan's complete detachment from Earth's biosphere.
sources: Brians, Paul. Study Guide for William Gibson: Neuromancer (1984). WSU.

annotations.target_phrase: silence in the corridors, approaching the terminal core of the AI
annotations.annotation_text: The oppressive silence of Straylight contrasts with the roaring data-streams of cyberspace. Here at the apex of corporate power, the architecture is hushed, cold, and dead, awaiting the seismic shock of the Kuang virus.
sources: Bukatman, Scott. Terminal Identity. Duke UP, 1993.
